note: Sandbox 6's audit (play/SPEC.md §4.6; intent 67f0404a): every input the page's numbers come from, each with its source (an artifact play keeps), a decision (Samuel's, dated) or an estimate and why. Nothing here is taken from the old Sandbox 6's figures; `old` lists what that page showed, for the report only.

livingPerson.label: Living space a resident has in Germany (net, Wohnfläche)

grossFactor.label: Gross floor area of a multi-family building to its living space (BGF ÷ Wohnfläche)

hotelRoom.label: Gross floor a hotel room or short stay, its share of corridors, lifts and back of house
hotelRoom.estimate: A mid-range room of 22–28 m² net plus 35–45 % for corridors, stairs, lifts and back of house: to be sourced

bedsHex.label: Beds planned a living hex
bedsHex.decided: Samuel 2026-11-09: layout B's 5 Dome80 + 9 Dome40, about 290 a hex

budget.label: What villagers and investors raise for the village's part
budget.decided: Samuel 2026-11-09: investors capped at €112,500 a new villager, €125,000 with the villager's own €12,500; about €175–200M

split.note: What the village's €200M pays for and what each coop invests itself (Samuel 2026-11-09), the same lines as the levelling intent 1df683fd's.
village: dome buildings (their shells, floors and glazing, the panels built into the glazing)
the homes inside the home domes
the Tower180's shell, floors, core, lifts and services
water works, wastewater and nutrient recycling
the tech container itself, its Starlink and server
coop: the works' and the dome factory's lines and machines (each works coop)
the food domes' production kit (the food coops)
the tower tenants' fit-out: shops, hotel, offices
the solar fields and their batteries (a solar coop)
the tech container's 50 kWp solar and battery (an energy coop)
the geothermal plant and its wells (a geothermal coop)

costsPending: The unit costs (dome shells, homes, land, roads, heat, water and power lines, energy plants), each sourced with low / typical / high, come from the market research under way; no cost is adopted before then.
